permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: Streams what the glasses microphone hears to your speech-to-text service so it can be shown as live captions.

permissions.name: phone-microphone
permissions.desc: Optional: use the phone microphone instead of the glasses microphone for captions.

permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Sends microphone audio to the speech-to-text service you pick (ElevenLabs or Wispr Flow) and receives the transcript.
